summary: Performance lens of the story pass. The sweep adds only keyword arguments to existing calls — no new I/O, no extra passes. check_encoding_hygiene is a single AST walk over factory/scripts (sub-second, verified: 'encoding hygiene: OK' returns immediately) run once per PR and at stage close. The locale-forced CI step re-runs five fast checkers, adding well under a minute to scaffold-check. No hot-path changes.

non_blocking_findings.summary: the no-UTF-8-locale step re-runs the standalone checkers (~seconds each); acceptable for the regression net it buys
